name: Hero banner - MCP proof
prompt: A wide cinematic campaign image: one unbranded white running shoe resting on a wet black stone ledge in the right third of the frame, lit by a cool rim light, with fine mist and soft dawn light over a blurred mountain lake behind it. The left two thirds stay calm and uncluttered, a smooth gradient of sky and water ready for a headline. Premium, minimal and crisp. No text, logos or watermarks.
